LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT GREGORY YANCEY'S DEMURRER TO SECOND AMENDED COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 9 BECAUSE THE DEFENDANT IS NOT AMONG THOSE NAMES IN SECTION 36.72. OTHERWISE OVERRULED. EVEN IF SECTION (47B) COULD APPLY IT IS NOT NECESSARILY TRUE FROM THE FACTS PLEADED THAT DEFENDANT ACTED IN GOOD FAITH CONTEMPLATION OF LITIGATION OR REPORTING TO THE GOVERNMENT. PLAINTIFF HAS PLEADED MALICE THAT DEFENDANT ACTED AT LEAST IN PART AS AN OUTSIDE CONTRACTOR CAPABLE OF AIDING AND ABETTING, AND THAT DEFENDANT ACQUIRED AND DISCLOSED INFORMATION BEYOND THE SCOPE OF ANY VALID RELEASE. 10 DAYS TO ANSWER.
